variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: Chicken liver (10%), dried eggs (6%), tapioca starch, animal fat (pork fat purified at 99.5%), fish oil (salmon oil purified at 99.5%), inactivated brewer’s yeast, pork meat, dried peas, salmon, hydrolysed animal proteins, minerals, hydrolysed yeasts 1% (of which free nucleotides 44%), pea fibre, xylo-oligosaccharides (0.4%), dried green tea leaves (0.05%). Protein sources: Eggs and chicken liver with a digestibility higher than 85%.

Analytical constituents: Crude protein: 6.8%, crude fibre: 0.4%, crude fat: 7.3%, crude ash: 2.5%, moisture: 75.4%, calcium: 0.25%, phosphorus: 0.09%, sodium: 0.08%, magnesium: 0.02%, potassium: 0.17%, chlorides: 0.35%, sulphur: 0.01%, total vitamin D: 232 IU/kg, hydroxyproline: 0%, n-3 fatty acids: 0.3%, n-6 fatty acids: 1.4%. Urine alkalising substance: potassium citrate 0.2%. Metabolisable energy: 1,260 kcal/kg.

Additives: NUTRITIONAL ADDITIVES/kg: Vitamin D3 225 IU, Vitamin E (all-rac-alpha-tocopheryl acetate 3a700i) 50 mg, Selenium (sodium selenite 0.04 mg) 0.02 mg, Manganese (manganous sulphate monohydrate 13 mg) 4.3 mg, Zinc (zinc oxide 26 mg) 21 mg, Copper (copper (II) sulphate pentahydrate 6.7 mg) 1.7 mg, Iron (iron (II) sulphate monohydrate 21 mg) 7 mg, Iodine (calcium iodate anhydrous 1.8 mg) 0.9 mg, L-cystine 600 mg, DL-methionine technically pure 300 mg, L-carnitine 300 mg, taurine 200 mg.
